result.topic_en: The page holds formula-only notes on the Dirichlet kernel integral for the convergence of Fourier series, including boundary values at x = ±π. It also has a potential-type sum, logarithmic expressions, and repeated integration by parts of the logarithmic integral ∫dx/log x and ∫log log x dx/log x.

methods.what: Dirichlet integral for the partial sum of a Fourier series, with substitution α−x=2β
Split of the integral into two halves u and v
Substitution β=π−γ for the part of the interval beyond π/2
Limit of v as h→∞ inside the interval
Derivative of a sum of inverse-distance (potential) terms
Integration by parts recursion for ∫dx/(log x)^n
Asymptotic expansion of the logarithmic integral
Integration by parts of ∫log log x dx/log x
